task_description: Complete rewrite of the voice assistant with simple Gemini-first architecture. No local state machine, no complex flows. Everything goes to Gemini, frontend just executes the response.

verification.summary: Syntax verified (3862 lines, 1461/1461 braces perfectly balanced, 298/298 parens in voice section). Pre-existing paren imbalance of -3 in head section unchanged. Cache buster updated to v=49. Cloud Function rewritten with simplified 6-action schema and conversational historial.

findings.architecture_change: Replaced 1265-line complex state machine (flujo guiado, parsearMaterialLocal, procesarEnFlujo, disambiguation sub-states) with 448-line simple Gemini-first architecture. Local nav only for instant response, everything else goes to Cloud Function.
findings.cloud_function_changes: Rewrote SYSTEM_PROMPT to simplified 6-action schema (ejecutar_orden, respuesta, navegar, consulta, abrir_orden, agregar_inventario). Added conversational historial support (last 6 messages sent as multi-turn conversation to Vertex AI).
findings.pre_existing: Paren imbalance of -3 exists in the first 3413 lines (pre-existing, unchanged from before).
